beats.intro: Meet {{UR AMAN|U R Amaan}}, the {{UR ISA|U R I S A}} notifications platform. [[sub]]Here's the compliance monitoring and remediation workflow.
beats.extract: From the {{ISA|I S A}} dashboard, [[hist]]extract the completion histories for the mandatory [[c1]]Information Essentials and [[c2]]Phishing courses, and the [[pol]]Computer Use Policy acknowledgements, forms [[f1]]{{9595|ninety-five ninety-five}} and [[f2]]{{9696|ninety-six ninety-six}}.
beats.dlp: Then access the Antileak {{DLP|D L P}} system to identify [[open]]open cases. Make sure every case is resolved within [[five]]five days of the initial notification email sent to the user.
beats.q1: Quick check. Which case is past the limit?
beats.upload: First, [[up]]upload the consolidated reports to the {{UR AMAN|U R Amaan}} tool. [[calc]]Training status is calculated by department, and [[flag]]overdue or expiring courses are flagged.
beats.filter: [[filt]]Filter by requirement to see [[miss]]missing policy acknowledgements. And on the [[dlp]]{{DLP|D L P}} page, cases [[past]]past the limit are highlighted.
beats.notify: Next, open [[send]]Send Notifications. {{UR AMAN|U R Amaan}} sends automated reminders to [[emp]]employees and their [[mgr]]managers to [[r1]]complete expired courses, [[r2]]finalize the Computer Use Policy acknowledgement and [[r3]]close outstanding {{DLP|D L P}} cases.
beats.q2: Quick check. Who gets the reminder?
beats.report: {{UR AMAN|U R Amaan}} generates the Phishing Assessment report with employees [[t]]tested, [[p]]passed, [[n]]neutral and [[f]]failed, the [[trend]]trend across assessments, and the results by [[dept]]department.
beats.distribute: Then distribute it with the [[mail]]Management Report Email to show {{UR|U R}}'s [[prog]]progress and current [[kpi]]{{KPI|K P I}} status.
beats.wrap: That's {{UR AMAN|U R Amaan}}. [[w1]]Extract, [[w2]]remediate and [[w3]]report, [[end]]all in one place.
beats.final1: Chapter practice. Sort each task into its step, then answer the two questions.
beats.finish: Well done. That's the {{UR AMAN|U R Amaan}} workflow.
